source: Chroma ATE press release: Chroma Unveils Next-Generation High Power Density AC Source (08-03-2026)

players.product: system-level test (SLT) platforms for AI accelerators and power test equipment

quarterly_data.signal: Chroma launched the 61860HF Regenerative Grid Simulator, the latest addition to its AC source portfolio, at the OCP APAC Summit 2026 in Taipei: up to 60 kVA of output power in a compact 5U chassis; the company says it achieves 14.7 times higher power density and an 87% reduction in system height and weight versus conventional solutions in the same power class. It is designed for AI-era server power validation (fast dynamic response, extreme power line disturbance simulation, ITIC pre-compliance testing), with output voltage extension, high-voltage operation through series connection of multiple units and fiber-optic communication for parallel operation.
quarterly_data.figure: 60 kVA in a 5U chassis; 14.7 times higher power density; 87% reduction in system height and weight
